findings.claim: The KBD boundary recorder is implemented but never wired into the KBD hook configuration, so task/change/phase boundaries will not invoke it.
findings.evidence: The added spec `openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging/spec.md` requires: "Successful KBD task, change and phase boundaries SHALL invoke the Karpathy progress recorder through a Node entry point." The diff adds `.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-boundary.mjs` and `.claude/hooks/src/karpathy-boundary.mts`, but contains no hunk modifying existing `.kbd-orchestrator/hooks-config.json` from the file_tree to call that entry point.
findings.suggested_fix: Add augment entries in `.kbd-orchestrator/hooks-config.json` for task, change, and phase boundaries that invoke `node .claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-boundary.mjs --boundary <task|change|phase>`.

findings.claim: Conversation/event log content remains present in the repository tree even though the new spec requires it to be excluded from version control.
findings.evidence: The added spec `openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging/spec.md` requires: "Files under `.prometheus/` that contain conversation text or absolute local paths ... the knowledge-base event log) MUST be excluded from version control by `.prometheus/.gitignore`." The packet file_tree lists `./.prometheus/events.jsonl`, and the diff only adds `events.jsonl` to `.prometheus/.gitignore` without deleting or untracking the existing `.prometheus/events.jsonl`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `.prometheus/events.jsonl` from the committed tree (for example `git rm --cached .prometheus/events.jsonl` if it must remain local) so the new `.prometheus/.gitignore` exclusion actually prevents it from being versioned.
